'''Artom''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Reidi Artom I system]],<ref name="LFCG" /> a part of the [[Nuon e Safyd sector/Legends|Nuon e Safyd sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Artom was the first discovery of [[Reidi Artom]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who was dispatched to the Expansion Region to survey any [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] missed by previous explorers.<ref name="LFCG" />

Artom,<ref name="LFCG" /> who had a penchant for naming systems she discovered after<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040115manifesto|text=Reidi Artom's Expansion Manifesto}}</ref> her own name<ref name="LFCG" /> or variations thereof instead of adhering to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] standard of naming a system after its [[Star/Legends|star]] or central planet,<ref name="Wizards" /> discovered the planet Artom at some point<ref name="LFCG" /> by [[232 BBY/Legends|232 BBY]].<ref name="Date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' dates [[Reidi Artom]]'s rediscovery and naming of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Reidi Artom VI system]] to 200 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which corresponds to [[232 BBY/Legends|232 BBY]], per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Since the ''Living Force Campaign Guide'' also establishes that the [[Reidi Artom I system]] was discovered before Reidi Artom VI, the former's discovery must have taken place at some point by that date.</ref> Although the discovery of the Reidi Artom I system did not prove especially profitable to Artom, the planet she found there still bore her name more than [[31 BBY/Legends|200 years]] later&mdash;as opposed to most of her other discoveries, which eventually reverted to local or ancient names.<ref name="LFCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Artom was mentioned in the ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2001]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] sourcebook authored by [[Robert Wiese]] and [[Andy Collins]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="LFCG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Artom system, and therefore the planet Artom, in grid square J-15;<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Reidi Artom I system]]</ref> however, in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to that book the placement was changed to grid square P-12&mdash;closer to square P-14 of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> another system explored by Reidi Artom.<ref name="LFCG" />
